cueCard.topic: Describe a famous person you would like to meet.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you would like to meet this person.

questions.text: Describe a famous person you would like to meet.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a famous person you would like to meet. You should say: who this person is; what they are famous for; how you know about them; and explain why you would like to meet this person.

questions.text: What would you ask this person if you met them?
questions.say: Thank you. What would you ask this person if you met them?

questions.text: Why do so many young people want to be famous?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a famous person you would like to meet, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all fame. Why do so many young people want to be famous?

questions.text: What are the disadvantages of being famous?
questions.say: What are the disadvantages of being famous?

questions.text: Is it easier to become famous now than it was in the past?
questions.say: Is it easier to become famous now than it was in the past?

questions.text: Should the media report on the private lives of famous people?
questions.say: Now let's talk about celebrities and the media. Should the media report on the private lives of famous people?

questions.text: Do celebrities have a responsibility to set a good example?
